title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam emphasizing on courage and wisdom
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the traits of courage and wisdom:
"अद्वैधमनसं युक्तं शूरं धीरं विपश्चितम्।
न श्रीः सन्त्यजते नित्यमादित्यमिव रश्मयः॥"
It says that prosperity ever remains with one who is courageous, steadfast, wise and endowed with strength, just as the rays always remain with the Sun.
The Prime Minister posted on X:
अद्वैधमनसं युक्तं शूरं धीरं विपश्चितम्।
न श्रीः सन्त्यजते नित्यमादित्यमिव रश्मयः॥
